actions.1_half_step_up_2: +1 = a half step up, +2 = a whole step. The tempo doesn't change.
actions.80_slower_120_faster_pitch: 80 % = slower, 120 % = faster. The pitch doesn't change, unless you put semitones.
actions.acoustic_electric_piano_synths_h: Acoustic or electric piano. Synths and horns may land here or stay in the rest. It isn't in All: pick it on songs that have piano
actions.each_instrument_gives_two_files: Each instrument gives two files: the instrument alone and the rest of the song. "All" gives vocals, drums, bass and guitar plus "other", without the "no X" ones. Piano isn't in "All": pick it on songs that have piano (synths stay in the rest).
actions.long_picked_song: as long as the picked song
actions.results_are_kept_key_txt: The results are kept in key.txt and bpm.txt, in each song's folder.
actions.send_stem_version_pick_checkbox: To send a stem or a version, pick it with its checkbox.
actions.song_picked_bpm_if_already: With a song picked, its BPM (if already detected; for a version at another speed, adjusted), its length and the bars that cover it are filled in: for one more bar, add 1. With a single song picked, the click carries its name and stays with its files.
actions.splits_drums_into_kick_snare: Splits the drums into kick, snare, toms, hi-hat, ride and crash (plus the rest of the drums). If the song doesn't have the drums separated yet, it separates them first
data.delete_uses_know_which_download: "delete" uses it to know which download it came from: it isn't changed.
data.going_named_all_files: It's going to be named "{number}{name}{ext}", with all its files.
data.label: Label
data.only_program_saves_file_writes: Only the program that saves the file writes it.
data.saved_song_reaper_takes_are: It's saved in the song{others}{kinds}. REAPER takes are left as they are.
data.saves_opens_next_songs_data: Saves and opens the next song's data
data.song_wizard_version_made_file: The song-wizard version that made this file (each file has its own): it isn't changed.
data.title: Title
data.was_last_song_list: That was the last song in the list.
delete.each_picked_song_goes_all: Each picked song goes with all its files and its results (key, tempo, click); if it was from a playlist, "check for new songs" downloads it again.
delete.if_you_make_mistake_you: If you make a mistake, you can get them back from the system's trash.
header.interface_off_use_again_terminal: The interface is off. To use it again, in the terminal:
header.light_dark_system_says: Light or dark as the system says
header.paste_link_song_playlist: Paste the link of a song or a playlist
header.reload_page_if_already_running: (or reload this page if it's already running).
header.restarting_song_wizard_page_reloa: Restarting song-wizard… this page reloads on its own when it's ready.
header.see_change_keyboard_shortcuts: See and change the keyboard shortcuts (?)
header.where_new_playlists_folder_goes: Where a new playlist's folder goes
jobs.closes_interface_which_keeps_runnin: Closes the interface, which keeps running in the background even if you close the page (like song-wizard ui --stop)
jobs.put_together_report_ask_help: Put together a report to ask for help
jobs.puts_together_file_computers_state: Puts together a file with this computer's state and the last things that happened, to ask for help
keys.add_another_key_same_thing: Add another key for the same thing
keys.all_changes_you_made_shortcuts: All the changes you made to the shortcuts are deleted.
keys.assign_pads_pedals_keys_connected: To assign pads, pedals or keys of a connected MIDI device (the browser asks for permission)
keys.browser_didnt_give_permission_use: The browser didn't give permission to use MIDI.
keys.browser_doesnt_handle_midi_chrome: This browser doesn't handle MIDI (Chrome and Edge do).
keys.change_key_click_press_new: To change a key, click it and press the new one; "+" adds another for the same thing and × removes it. A pedal that sends keys works too, or a MIDI pad or pedal. They're saved in this browser. While you're typing in a text field they do nothing.
keys.first_pick_song_clicking: First pick a song with ↑ ↓ (or by clicking it).
keys.go_back_factory_shortcuts: Go back to the factory shortcuts?
keys.lyrics_times_mark_next_line: Lyrics times: mark the next line
keys.monitor_on_off: Turn the monitor on or off (the mic in your headphones)
keys.pick_song_drop_from_selection: Pick the song (or drop it from the selection)
keys.save_go_next_song: Save and go on to the next song
keys.see_how_far_apart_tracks: See how far apart the tracks are
keys.start_if_marked: To the start (or to A, if marked)
keys.they_swap_goes: They swap: "{label}" goes to {v} and "{label2}" to {v2}.
keys.turn_click_off: Turn the click on or off
library.chords_check_click: This song had no click adjusted: I'll find it first. If the chords don't fall in place, check the click in Practice and detect again.
library.chords_kept_by_hand: what you corrected by hand stays; see and correct them in Practice
library.chords_on_click: on the click's beats; see and correct them in Practice
library.current_one_goes_trash: the current one goes to the trash
library.cut_start_end_add_silence: cut the start or the end, or add silence
library.detect_again_from_audio_replaces: Detect it again from the audio (replaces what was set by hand)
library.files_data_alone_note_version: This file's data alone (a note on this version, say)
library.filter_words_from_name_folder: Filter: words from the name, folder, artist, album…
library.find_type_them_mark_them: find or type them, to mark them
library.has_lyrics_reaper_project: It has lyrics, chords, notes or a REAPER project
library.hide_every_songs_stems_versions: Hide every song's stems and versions
library.i_cant_find_folder_if: I can't find this folder: if you moved or renamed it, its songs won't show until it's there again (for a playlist, "song-wizard archives --move" records where it is now).
library.i_didnt_find_reaper_installed: I didn't find REAPER installed on this computer
library.list_print_each_song_key: A list to print: each song with its key, tempo and length, and the total
library.looks_at_playlist_again_download: Looks at the playlist "{title}" again and downloads only the songs that were added
library.more_actions_songs_data_lyrics: More actions: the song's data, lyrics, trimming, the REAPER project
library.no_songs_yet_paste_url: No songs yet. Paste a URL above to download, or copy audio files to your music folder.
library.not_version_already_transposed_a: Not on a version already transposed or at another speed: do it from the original (with speed and semitones together if needed), which sounds better.
library.notes_from_stems: from the separated stems; what you corrected by hand stays; see and correct them in Practice
library.open_music_folder: Open the music folder in the {fileManager}
library.pick_only_file_shift_everything: Pick only this file (with Shift, everything since the last one picked)
library.pick_song_shift_everything_since: Pick the song (with Shift, everything since the last one picked)
library.playlist_outside_your_music_fold: This playlist is outside your music folder
library.practice_mix_stems_slow_down: Practice: mix the stems, slow down and loop a section
library.read_music_folder_again_also: Read the music folder again (it's also done on its own when coming back to this tab)
library.reaper_isnt_installed_only_file: REAPER isn't installed: only the file is created
library.run_command_wsl_terminal_asks: Run this command in the WSL terminal (it asks for your password) and click "↻ refresh". To have it connect on its own every time, add the line "{drive}: /mnt/{v} drvfs defaults,nofail 0 0" to /etc/fstab.
library.separating_works_original_song_n: Separating works on the original song, not on stems, versions or other copies.
library.set_hand_click_change: Set by hand. Click to change it
library.show_every_songs_stems_versions: Show every song's stems and versions
library.stems_tempo_click_opens: with the stems, the tempo and the click; and opens it
library.title_artist_album_artist_title: title, artist, album… (artist and title change its name)
library.wsl_doesnt_see_drive_happens: WSL doesn't see drive {drive}: (it happens with Google Drive's after restarting WSL), so its songs don't show.
lyrics.change_moment_thats_playing: Change it to the moment that's playing
lyrics.click_change_empty_deletes: Click to change it (empty deletes it)
lyrics.drag_over_lyrics_click_word: {toolName}: drag over the lyrics, or click a word. Click the tool again to let go of it.
lyrics.drag_over_lyrics_click_word_2: {toolName}: drag over the lyrics, or click a word. It takes whole words. Esc lets go of the tool{undo}.
lyrics.eraser_drag_over_click_whats: Eraser: drag over or click what's marked to remove its color
lyrics.every_time_half_second_earlier: Every time half a second earlier
lyrics.every_time_half_second_later: Every time half a second later
lyrics.line_being_sung_highlighted_own: The line being sung is highlighted on its own.
lyrics.lines_you_dont_change_keep: The lines you don't change keep their colors and notes.
lyrics.looks_them_up_open_lyrics: Looks them up in an open lyrics database, by the song's name and length
lyrics.mark_piece_mouse_click_color: Mark a piece with the mouse and click a color (or "no color" to remove it). "note" adds a comment to the marked line. Next to each color you can write what it means (who sings, chorus, break…). It's saved on its own.
lyrics.note_click_line_write_comment: Note: click a line to write it a comment
lyrics.note_click_line_you_want: Note: click the line you want to comment on.
lyrics.note_click_line_you_want_2: Note: click the line you want to comment on. Esc lets go of the tool.
lyrics.opens_lyrics_their_colors_notes: Opens the lyrics with their colors and notes in another tab, to print them or save them as PDF
lyrics.pick_marker_color_drag_over: Pick a marker (a color{v}) and drag it over the lyrics, or click a word. Next to each color write what it means. It's saved on its own.
lyrics.pick_marker_run_over_lyrics: Pick a marker and run it over the lyrics, or click a word.
lyrics.put_here_moment_thats_playing: Put here the moment that's playing
lyrics.replaces_lyrics_their_colors_note: It replaces the lyrics, and their colors and notes are lost (the legend stays).
lyrics.show_column_moment_each_line: Show the column with the moment each line starts, to set or correct them
lyrics.song_has_no_lyrics_yet: This song has no lyrics yet.
lyrics.song_has_no_lyrics_yet_2: This song has no lyrics yet. "find the lyrics" looks them up by its name and length; if they don't show up, "write or paste".
lyrics.type_lyrics_paste_them_from: Type the lyrics or paste them from elsewhere
lyrics.type_paste_them_lyrics_library: (to type or paste them: "lyrics" in the library)
lyrics.while_plays_click_lines_time: While it plays, click a line's time right when it starts being sung{key}. × clears it. Double-click a line: go to that moment.
monitor.clipping: overloading: move the mic away or lower its level in Windows
monitor.delay_without_input: delay ≈ {v} ms (not counting the mic's, which the browser doesn't tell)
monitor.echo_warning: Heads-up: the mic comes in with some delay (shown next to it). With the drums playing, your own hit can sound doubled: keep it low, to hear the band and the room more than your drums.
monitor.hear_room_through_mic: Hear the room through the mic, mixed with the tracks, without taking your headphones off
monitor.level_reaching_mic: What reaches the mic (the monitor's volume doesn't change it)
monitor.limiter_off_explained: Limiter off: a loud peak at the mic reaches your ears in full. Mind the volume.
monitor.limiter_on_explained: Limiter on: it only holds back single peaks over {v} dB (a cymbal near the mic, a knock on the mic) to look after your ears; the normal volume doesn't change. It adds about 6 ms of delay. If you don't want it, untick it.
monitor.low_cut_explained: Takes the low end out of the mic (below 120 Hz): the kick reaches you through your body anyway, and it's what most overloads a laptop mic
monitor.mic_busy: The mic is busy (is another program using it?).
monitor.needs_secure_page: The browser only lets the mic be used with the page open on this PC (localhost) or over https.
monitor.permission_denied: The browser didn't allow the mic: allow it in the padlock on the address bar and try again.
player.browser_couldnt_play_format: The browser couldn't play that format.
player.pick_file_play: Pick a file with ▶ to play it
playlists.add_folder_note: A folder copied from another computer or kept in Drive: its songs show in the library, and the playlists song-wizard downloaded (in that folder or the ones inside it) join this list, without downloading again what they have.
playlists.downloaded_songs_arent_touched: The downloaded songs aren't touched. If you download it again, all its songs are downloaded again.
playlists.downloads_only_songs_added_pla: Downloads only the songs added to the playlist
playlists.each_new_playlist_saved_folder: Each new playlist is saved in a folder with its name inside this one. The ones you already downloaded stay where they are (to take them elsewhere, "move" in Downloaded playlists).
playlists.folders_carry_their_record: Each playlist keeps its record in its folder: copied to another computer or kept in Drive, you can go on looking for new songs there.
playlists.forgetting_playlist_makes_down: Forgetting a playlist makes it download whole again next time. It never deletes the songs.
playlists.goes_whole_songs_stems_results: It goes whole (songs, stems and results) to a new folder inside the one you choose, and new songs are downloaded there.
playlists.new_playlists_go_your_music: New playlists go to your music folder
playlists.next_time_downloaded_whole_aga: Next time it's downloaded whole again. The songs aren't deleted.
playlists.opens_systems_folder_picker_ma: Opens the system's folder picker (it may show up behind the browser)
playlists.windows_path_g_my_drive: A Windows path (G:\My Drive\...) or a Linux/Mac one works. The folder has to exist.
practice.browser_couldnt_change_pitch_li: This browser couldn't change the pitch live.
practice.browser_didnt_allow_full_screen: The browser didn't allow full screen.
practice.chord_drag_border: Drag to move the chord change (it snaps to the beats; with Alt, free)
practice.chord_now_title: The chord playing now and the next one
practice.chord_unknown: song-wizard doesn't read this as a chord: it's saved anyway, but it isn't transposed or simplified.
practice.chords_detect_title: Detects the song's chords and places them on the click's beats (and the notes, if the bass or the voice is separated). What you corrected by hand stays.
practice.chords_need_click: The chords go on the click's beats: adjust it first (so its lines fall on the hits, or press Detect there), then detect the chords.
practice.click_at_tempo_meter_adjust: The click, at the tempo and meter of "Adjust the click"
practice.click_now_adjusted_song: The click is now adjusted to the song.
practice.click_waveform_go_there_wheel: click a waveform to go there; the wheel zooms in and out
practice.bar_now_title: The bar and beat playing, by the click
practice.detect_notes_title: Detects this stem's notes (the first time, the voice one downloads its model, 89 MB)
practice.double_if_detected_one_came: Double: if the detected one came out half
practice.drag_over_picture_so_lines: Drag over the picture so the lines fall on the song's hits; the marked one is the first beat of each bar.
practice.finds_exact_tempo_first_beat: Finds the exact tempo and the first beat in the song
practice.from_start_click_count: From the start, with the click and the count-in
practice.full_screen_without_browsers_ba: Full screen, without the browser's bars
practice.half_if_detected_one_came: Half: if the detected one came out double
practice.jobs_none_for_song: You haven't sent anything for this song.
practice.jobs_title: What you sent to run (detecting chords, notes, the click…) and how it is going
practice.listen_notes_title: Hear the detected notes with a soft tone (they follow the speed and the pitch)
practice.look_here_title: Moves this view to the point that's playing, to line up the lines where the beat is clear (it holds for the whole song)
practice.note_invalid: Type a note like E, Eb or F#2 (the number is the octave).
practice.offset_between_tracks_now_ms: offset between tracks: now {v} ms · max {v2} ms · learned start delay {v3} ms
practice.only_track_others_can_added: Only this track (others can be added)
practice.print_chords_title: Opens the lyrics with the chords over them to print, in this pitch
practice.simplify_title: Show only major and minor (A7 → A, Am7 → Am)
practice.speed_changes_without_changing_: The speed changes without changing the pitch
practice.start_song_drag_move_click: Start of the song: drag to move the click
practice.whole_song_box_what_tracks: The whole song: the box is what the tracks show; drag it to move
reaper.box_below_jobs_there_you: box, below Jobs: there you can see it again and put it back whenever you want.
reaper.changes_preference_now_reaper_clo: Changes that preference now (with REAPER closed)
reaper.current_project_goes_trash_whatev: The current project goes to the trash, with whatever you changed in REAPER, and a new one is made with the stems there are now.
reaper.done_reaper_preference_back_was: Done: the REAPER preference is back as it was.
reaper.i_didnt_find_reaper_installed: I didn't find REAPER installed on this computer: projects can still be created (from "more" on each song), but not opened from here.
reaper.name_takes_after_their_song: Name takes after their song again (with REAPER closed)
reaper.no_tempo_was_detected_song: No tempo was detected for this song: the project is at 120 BPM.
reaper.put_back_was: put it back as it was
reaper.puts_only_preference_back_was: Puts only that preference back as it was (with REAPER closed); song-wizard won't change it again
reaper.putting_back_restores_only_line: Putting it back restores only that line, without touching anything else in REAPER. Afterwards, new takes won't show with their song. By hand: in that REAPER preference, put what "Before" says (or "song-wizard reaper --setting restore" in the terminal).
reaper.reaper_already_names_takes_after: REAPER already names takes after their song, so they show with it in the library.
reaper.reaper_hasnt_been_opened_computer: REAPER hasn't been opened on this computer yet. When you create or open a project from here, song-wizard sets the take names so they show with their song, and tells you.
reaper.reaper_isnt_installed_so_wasnt: REAPER isn't installed, so it wasn't opened.
reaper.reaper_open_close_first_saves: REAPER is open: close it first (it saves its preferences when closing and would overwrite the change).
reaper.so_takes_you_record_are: So the takes you record are named after their song and show with it, song-wizard changes a REAPER preference (with REAPER closed) the first time you create or open a project from here. It tells you when it does, and you can put it back from this box.
reaper.song_wizard_changed_reaper_prefer: On {changed} song-wizard changed a REAPER preference, so the takes you record are named after their song ("Song (record 2026-11-01 19-05-12).wav") and show with it in the library.
reaper.song_wizard_wont_change_again: ). song-wizard won't change it again, and new takes won't show with their song.
reaper.takes_show_their_song_close: For takes to show with their song, close REAPER and open the project from here again (see the REAPER box).
reaper.tempo_comes_from_bpm_txt: The tempo comes from bpm.txt, but the song isn't lined up to the bars: adjust the click in practice and redo the project.
reaper.undo_put_back_was_here: To undo it: "put it back as it was" (here or in the REAPER box), or by hand in that REAPER preference, putting what "Before" says.
reaper.you_put_back_reapers_take: On {restored} you put back REAPER's take names (
report.computers_state_last_things_song: with this computer's state and the last things song-wizard did. Your home folder shows as ~, but song and folder names stay: look it over before sending it.
report.no_github_account_send_file: No GitHub account? Send the file over WhatsApp or email to whoever helps you with song-wizard.
report.putting_report_together_checks_in: Putting the report together (it checks the installation, it takes a few seconds)…
report.report_couldnt_put_together_try: The report couldn't be put together: {message}. Try "song-wizard report" in the terminal.
report.tell_what_happened_drag_file: , tell what happened and drag the file in.
selection.list_print_picked_songs_from: A list to print with the picked songs, from any folder, in the order you want (a stem or a version counts as its song)
selection.pick_songs_library_single_file: Pick songs in the library, or a single file (a stem, say) with its checkbox. A folder's checkbox picks all its songs.
selection.send_whats_picked_trash_asks: Send what's picked to the trash (asks for confirmation)
server.data_changed_one_song_at: data is changed one song at a time
server.field_name_cant_empty_have: a field name can't be empty or have =
server.i_couldnt_make_reaper_project: I couldn't make the REAPER project (the detail is in the log).
server.i_couldnt_reach_lyrics_database: I couldn't reach the lyrics database (is there internet?).
server.i_didnt_find_file_manager: I didn't find a file manager on this system
server.i_didnt_find_songs_lyrics: I didn't find this song's lyrics: you can paste them with "write or paste".
server.isnt_key_try_am_c: "{value}" isn't a key: try Am, C#, Bb major or A minor
server.isnt_tempo_number_bpm_between: "{value}" isn't a tempo: a number of BPM between 20 and 400
server.lyrics_database_isnt_answering_ri: The lyrics database isn't answering right now (it's down or busy). Try again in a while.
server.one_those_isnt_song_library: one of those isn't a song of the library anymore
server.request_doesnt_come_from_song: This request doesn't come from song-wizard's interface.
server.song_has_no_lyrics_yet: this song has no lyrics yet
server.songs_are_renamed_one_at: songs are renamed one at a time
server.songs_are_trimmed_one_at: songs are trimmed one at a time
server.songs_practice_click_still_set: This song's practice click is still set to the previous tempo: fix it in practice → adjust the click.
server.url_has_start_http_https: the URL has to start with http:// or https://
server.wsl_doesnt_see_drive_happens: WSL doesn't see drive {letter}: (it happens with Google Drive's). Connect it by running this command in the WSL terminal (it asks for your password) and try again.
setlist.chords_none: with chords (none of these songs has them yet: they're detected in Practice)
setlist.chords_some: with chords over the lyrics ({some} of {n} songs have them)
setlist.drag_songs_change_order_save: Drag the songs to change the order (or use ↑ ↓). Printing saves nothing; "save the order in the folder" renumbers its files (001, 002…), and new songs join at the end.
setlist.drag_songs_change_order_use: Drag the songs to change the order (or use ↑ ↓). It's only for printing: nothing is saved and no folder is touched.
setlist.lyrics_none_these_songs_has: with lyrics (none of these songs has lyrics yet: more › Lyrics)
setlist.lyrics_their_marks_one_per: with the lyrics and their marks, one per page after the list ({which})
setlist.save_order: save the order in the folder
setlist.save_order_title: Renumbers the folder's songs (001, 002…) in this order; their stems, results, lyrics and REAPER project go with each one
sheet.approximate: Each one goes over the word being sung when it changes; it's approximate: if one lands wrong, correct that lyrics line's time in Practice.
sheet.no_bass_yet: (no bass notes yet: they're detected in Practice)
sheet.no_chords_yet: (no chords yet: they're detected in Practice)
sheet.no_click: The bars need the song's click: set it in Practice (Adjust the click).
sheet.no_lyrics_bars: This song has no lyrics: they go in bars.
sheet.no_times: The lyrics have no times, so they go in bars, before the lyrics. If you set the lyrics' times (in Practice, "times"), they go over the words, at the right moment. You can print it like this anyway.
sheet.setlist_chords: With chords over the lyrics (the songs that have them)
trim.browser_couldnt_play_song: The browser couldn't play the song.
trim.drag_two_handles_type_times: Drag the two handles, or type the times. The mouse wheel zooms in and out (with Shift, it moves sideways); a click on the waveform plays from there. Below, the whole song: drag the box to move.
trim.plays_5_seconds_from_chosen: Plays 5 seconds from the chosen start
trim.plays_last_5_seconds_before: Plays the last 5 seconds before the chosen end
trim.reaper_take_left: (a REAPER take: left as it is)
trim.song_has_reaper_project_going: This song has a REAPER project: it's going to be out of step. Redo it afterwards with "more › Redo REAPER project".
trim.song_stems_versions_are_trimmed: The song, its stems and versions are trimmed together (those at another speed, in proportion), and the practice click and the lyrics' times move along. The old files go to the trash.
trim.song_what_stays_marked: The song: what stays is marked
trim.whole_song_whats_marked_what: The whole song: what's marked is what stays, and the box, what's shown above; drag it to move
version.couldnt_checked_whether_theres_n: It couldn't be checked whether there's a new version (click to check again)
version.couldnt_updated_detail_jobs: It couldn't be updated: the detail is in Jobs.
version.downloads_version_whats_new_what: It downloads that version (and what's new in what it uses, like yt-dlp) and restarts the interface; this page reloads on its own.
version.i_couldnt_check_whether_theres: I couldn't check whether there's a new version (is there internet?).
version.interface_didnt_come_back_own: The interface didn't come back on its own: in the terminal, song-wizard ui, and reload this page.
version.jobs_are_running_update_when: Jobs are running: update when they finish.
version.latest_version_click_check_again: It's the latest version (click to check again)
version.still_running_will_cancelled: Still running: {v}. It will be cancelled.
version.use_again_song_wizard_ui: To use it again: song-wizard ui in the terminal.
